# WRAG

> WRAG is a stakes-based extraction shooter: deploy into a match, eliminate hostiles, and extract before you're taken out. Points earned during a match stay "at risk" - only extracting locks them in as secured; dying before that loses whatever's still unsecured.

## Pages

- [Home](https://wrag-fps.vercel.app/): Marketing landing page - how the risk/reward loop works, game modes, and sign-up.
- [Sign Up](https://wrag-fps.vercel.app/signup.html): New player registration.
- [Log In](https://wrag-fps.vercel.app/login.html): Existing player sign-in.

## Game modes

- Battle Royale (Versus): free-for-all, standard entry stake.
- Co-op: two squads, shared team score, respawns available.
- Private: invite-only room with an optional custom stake.
- Survival: solo vs. endless bots, no stakes, personal best score.

## Notes

- The dashboard, account, and admin pages require an authenticated session and are not publicly listed here (see robots.txt).
- The actual in-match gameplay runs as a separate real-time WebSocket/WebGL client, launched from the dashboard - this marketing site itself is static.
- All in-app currency (PTS) is virtual/demo - no real money is involved anywhere in this project.
